passage.label: Day people depart separated categories shown result deeds; whoever does atom weight good see it; whoever does atom weight evil see it

arabicExcerpts.text: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ

mainSubject.label: That Day people will depart separated into categories to be shown the results of their deeds; whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

subordinateSubjects.label: People departing separated into categories to be shown their deeds' results
Whoever does an atom's weight of good seeing it
Whoever does an atom's weight of evil seeing it

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Separated departure to witness one's own deeds' results
Atom-weight precision applied equally to good and evil

relationships.label: Absolute accountability at sub-atomic scale leaving no deed unshown

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the earth's news-reporting by divine command (5) before the human-departure scene opens (6); P2 covers the three-verse closing triad on separated departure and atom-weight precision of both good and evil (6-8).
